description: Add money to this agent's private Solana balance from its main wallet (the GLOAM_AGENT_SOLANA_KEY wallet), which pays Solana's fee. PUBLIC on chain: the main wallet, the asset and the amount (an add links the main wallet to its private account). Passes the owner's spending limits as tool "shield" on network "solana-mainnet".

amount.description: Amount in whole units, like "2.5" (not base units).

asset.description: SOL, USDC, USDT or ZEC (Zcash bridged to Solana by NEAR's Omni Bridge; private once added, the bridge and the add are public).

timeoutMs.description: How long to wait for Solana, in ms (default 120000). A send still unsettled then comes back pending with its signature and blockhash.

name: gloam_solana_add
title: Add money on Solana
